observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: MODELLED AS void AND BACKED BY THE DISASSEMBLY: the body is three instructions (0x0095fa30 MOV EAX,[ESP+0x4] / 0x0095fa34 MOV [ECX+0x80],EAX / 0x0095fa3a RET 0x4) and no instruction after the load writes EAX, so no result is materialised on any path; the word still in EAX at the RET is the copied argument, and nothing here claims it as a value. The SDK symbol table labels this method `bool` and Ghidra renders `bool UTFWin__Window__IsAncestorOf(IWindow *this, IWindow *pChildWindow)`, but no instruction sets AL or the upper three bytes of EAX, so a bool result is not derivable from the body; the disagreement is recorded in unresolved_questions rather than modelled. The residue could only be given a contract by a caller that consumes AL, and all 33 references to 0x0095fa30 are DATA vtable entries with no CALL site, so no such caller is statically visible.
observed_original_abi.locals: none; the body allocates no frame, saves no register and builds no record
observed_original_abi.outgoing_calls: none; the body holds no CALL, no JMP and no indirect transfer

observed_mechanics: 0x0095fa30 8b 44 24 04 - MOV EAX,dword ptr [ESP + 0x4]: the single callee-cleaned stack word is loaded into EAX unchanged.
0x0095fa34 89 81 80 00 00 00 - MOV dword ptr [ECX + 0x80],EAX: the loaded word is stored verbatim at receiver+0x80, the only memory write in the body.
0x0095fa3a c2 04 00 - RET 0x4: single exit; the callee pops the one 4-byte argument, so stack cleanup is 4 bytes and owned by the callee.

The body is 13 bytes and contains no branch, no call, no flag test, no register save and no loop: the store at +0x80 is unconditional, so a null argument still overwrites the slot and no prior value is read or preserved.
No instruction reads receiver+0x00, so no vtable pointer field is claimed on the receiver object; the vtable image is described as a standalone table instead.

33 references to 0x0095fa30 exist and every one is a DATA pointer, never a CALL site: the method is reached only through virtual dispatch. At each reference address R the four consecutive image words read [R]=0x0095fa30, [R+4]=0x0095fd60, [R+8]=0x0095fdc0, [R+0xc]=0x0095fe40.

The compilation of the staged reconstruction is byte-identical to the target body: g++ -m32 -O2 emits `8b 44 24 04 / 89 81 80 00 00 00 / c2 04 00` for is_ancestor_of_0095fa30, the same opcode sequence and the same 13-byte length as 0x0095fa30..0x0095fa3c.

semantic_findings.finding: The body is an unconditional pointer-sized store of the caller's single argument into receiver+0x80. Nothing is read, compared or branched on, so the function has no observable decision to make.

The SDK name IsAncestorOf and its bool result are not supported by the body: a three-instruction store that tests nothing cannot have computed an ancestry answer. Either the SDK label is misassigned, or this vtable slot is a setter/registration entry whose SDK name is wrong. The reconstruction models only the machine behaviour.

All 33 references are DATA vtable entries and there is no CALL reference, so the method is only ever entered through a vtable dispatch, and the EAX residue at the RET can only be observed by such a caller.

The trampoline is what pins the observed callee-cleanup ABI.
